data.name: Private Coronado Island E-Bike Tour
data.headline: Exclusive and Private Bike Tour For You and Yours
data.description: Embark on a personalized modern adventure with our exclusive 1.5-hour guided private e-bike tour of Coronado Island. Available daily at times that fit your schedule, this bespoke experience is tailored for individuals, families, and private groups seeking an intimate and flexible exploration. Coronado Bike and Surf is the only tour operator conveniently located directly at the iconic Hotel del Coronado, offering you a unique and exhilarating way to discover the island at your own pace. Our cutting-edge electric bikes amplify your pedaling power, allowing your group to effortlessly cover more ground, discover hidden coves, and soak in breathtaking coastal views. This fun and dynamic private ride is perfect for anyone looking to experience Coronado's rich history, stunning architecture, and vibrant community in an exciting new way, designed just for you.
data.highlights:
- Exclusive Private Experience: Enjoy a dedicated guide and a personalized tour tailored specifically for your individual needs, family, or private group.

- E-Bike Advantage: Experience the thrill of effortlessly exploring Coronado thanks to the power of our electric bikes, allowing you to cover more ground with ease.

- Unbeatable Location: We are the only bike tour operator based directly at the Hotel del Coronado, giving you the most convenient and seamless start to your adventure.

- Iconic Landmarks & More: See the majestic Hotel del Coronado, the charming Coronado Ferry Landing, historic Spreckels Park, and discover new perspectives with your private party.

- Panoramic Views: Take in stunning vistas of the San Diego skyline, Coronado Bridge, and the Pacific Ocean, all while enjoying a comfortable ride.

- Engaging Storytelling: Your expert guide will share fascinating insights into Coronado's history, architecture, and local life, with ample opportunity for questions.

- Customizable Pace: Set your own pace and enjoy stops when and where your group desires, making this an intimate and truly unique adventure.
data.what_is_included:
- 1.5-hour guided private e-bike tour of Coronado Island

- Premium electric bicycle rental for each participant

- Helmet (mandatory for all riders)

- Dedicated, local, experienced private tour guide

- Bottled water

- Tour in English
data.what_to_bring:
Comfortable clothing suitable for biking (e.g., shorts, t-shirt)

Closed-toe shoes (required for safety)

Sunglasses and sunscreen

Small backpack or fanny pack for personal items

Camera to capture memorable moments
data.cancellation_notes: Customers will receive a full refund or credit with 48 hours notice of cancellation. Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. Contact us by phone to cancel or inquire about a cancellation. No-shows will be charged the full price.
data.booking_notes: Thank you for booking your exclusive private e-bike adventure with Coronado Bike and Surf! Get ready to effortlessly explore the beautiful sights of Coronado Island on our comfortable electric bikes, with a dedicated guide just for your family or group. As the only operator conveniently located at the iconic Hotel del Coronado, we make starting your fun-filled, personalized tour incredibly easy, and we can't wait to share the island's charm with you. We're looking forward to an amazing private ride together!
data.check_in_details: Meet us at our beach shack located directly in front of the Hotel Del Coronado on the bike path.
data.disclaimers:
: Do I need to be an experienced cyclist for a private tour?
A: Not at all! Our e-bikes provide a boost, making the ride enjoyable and accessible for all skill levels, even if you haven't biked in years. Your private guide will ensure the pace is comfortable for everyone in your group.

Q: Are helmets provided?
A: Yes, helmets are provided and are mandatory for all riders for your safety.

Q: What kind of bikes do you use?
A: We use modern, comfortable electric beach cruiser style bicycles that provide pedal-assist, making every incline feel flat and every ride a breeze for your private group.

Q: Is there an age limit for a private tour?
A: Riders must be at least 12 years old and capable of safely operating an e-bike. Younger children may be accommodated with a tag-along or trailer by prior arrangement and availability; please contact us directly to inquire. All riders under 18 must be accompanied by an adult.

Q: What if it rains?
A: Our tours run rain or shine. In the event of severe weather conditions that make biking unsafe, we will work with your private group to reschedule or offer a full refund.

Q: Can I bring my own bike on a private tour?
A: Our tour price includes a high-performance e-bike rental designed for this experience. If you prefer to use your own bike, please contact us directly for pricing adjustments.
